title: MemTrial: Learning When to Trust Memory in LLM Portfolio Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.11732v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents for portfolio management learn from experience: they credit each experience in their memory with the outcome of the decisions that used it. In financial markets, however, this outcome mostly reflects the market move shared by all decisions on that date, so the credit tracks the market rather than the experience, and these agents often do worse than simply holding the equal-weight (1/$N$) portfolio. We ask how an agent can credit an experience with what it changes, and answer it by putting memory on trial: drafts of the same decision with and without an experience face the same market, so the outcome they share cancels in their difference. Our agent, MemTrial, drafts each decision with eight combinations of its retrieved experiences, chosen by a fractional factorial design, and credits each experience with its Banzhaf value, the average of these differences. translated_title: MemTrial：学习何时信任 LLM 投资组合智能体中的记忆
translated_abstract: 用于投资组合管理的大语言模型（LLM）智能体从经验中学习：它们将记忆中的每条经验与使用该经验的决策结果进行归因。然而在金融市场中，这一结果大多反映了当天所有决策共同面对的市场走势，因此这种归因追踪的是市场而非经验本身，这些智能体的表现往往不如简单地持有等权重（1/N）投资组合。我们提出了一个问题：智能体如何将经验归因于它真正改变的东西，并通过“审判记忆”来回答这一问题：包含与不包含某条经验的同一决策草案面对的是同一个市场，因此它们共享的结果会在两者之差中相互抵消。我们的智能体 MemTrial 使用由部分因子设计选出的八种检索经验组合为每个决策起草草案，并以每条经验的 Banzhaf 值（即这些差值的平均值）对经验进行归因。由于每个日期只出现一次，且每个草案……
tldr: 提出 MemTrial 智能体，通过在相同市场下对比包含与不包含某条经验的决策草案的结果差异，并以 Banzhaf 值为经验归因，解决了传统经验归因只反映市场走势的问题，使智能体学会何时信任记忆。
en_tdlr: MemTrial learns when to trust memory in LLM portfolio agents by crediting each experience with its Banzhaf value—the average outcome difference between decision drafts with and without that experience facing the same market—so that shared market movements cancel out.
